capabilities: Render flowcharts from flowchart.js code blocks in notes
Customize flowchart styles such as line width, font size, and colors in settings
Configure styling for individual elements like start/end symbols and decision conditions
Customize labels for decision paths (Yes/No text)
disambiguation: Uses flowchart.js syntax in code blocks, not Mermaid, for its diagrams.
extras: README includes build, manual installation, and troubleshooting instructions; further examples are linked in a separate test note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render flowcharts from flowchart.js markup inside notes.
summary: Diagram renderer that draws flowcharts in notes from flowchart.js code blocks, with configurable line, font, and color styling.
